videos.title: Dashboard and financial transparency
videos.about: The homeowner dashboard as one video: the balance and due date, what needs attention, requests and notices, what is coming up, quick actions, where the dues go against what was spent, and one dashboard for two homes.

videos.title: Resident, household and property profiles
videos.about: Profiles from the homeowner's side and the office's: names and contact details, the owner profile, directory privacy, who lives at the home, a tenant invitation, the home's contacts, two homes on one account, the home timeline, and a removal that keeps the history.

videos.title: Selling a home and handing it over
videos.about: The whole ownership transfer in one video: a sale reported, the account reviewed, the package prepared, the buyer invited, the handoff confirmed, the history kept, and a second claim on a home decided by the board.

videos.title: Violations, from notice to resolution
videos.about: The whole violations feature in one video: the community's own types, a notice drafted with a photo and approved by a second person, the homeowner's acknowledgment and correction, a hearing, the fix verified, and the complete history.

videos.title: Board and community administration
videos.about: The whole board and community administration feature in one video: the work queue in priority order, assigning a request, residents and properties, money for the roles allowed, the board's summary and controls, a confirmed bulk close and a message template, the board roster with terms, committees and decisions, and a management company's several communities.

videos.title: Activity log and protected history
videos.about: The whole activity log and protected history feature in one video: a homeowner's own activity and the home's timeline, the history inside a payment and a request, the protected record with who, when, what changed and why, its filters and an export that is itself recorded, records nobody can edit and that never keep card numbers, and a legal hold placed with a reason.

videos.title: HOA HX support access
videos.about: The whole HOA HX support access feature in one video: the community authorizes support for one case with a reason, a read-only scope and a length, after its password again; HOA HX support sees the authorization and who approved it, with no way to change it; while support looks, the community sees it by role and time, and a revoke ends the look at once; afterwards support has no standing access; on HOA HX's account list there is no Impersonate without the community's authorization, and resetting a person's two-factor sign-in needs a recorded check of who they are.

videos.title: The right person for each job
videos.about: The whole assignable designations feature in one video: the community's Account Owner, a Billing Administrator, a handover and a backup contact, a home's primary owner changed with the deed while the co-owner keeps every right, a home's communication contact and household administrator, an owner's rental manager for a range of dates, and a committee member who reviews a request while the decision stays with the President.

videos.title: The monthly numbers: budget against actual
videos.about: How the board shows where the money actually went, and how a community's homes come in from its own spreadsheet: the Treasurer reads the month's profit and loss into the budget's categories and records the statement, a homeowner compares the budget with what was actually spent and can open the statement itself, and the board's Budget vs. Actual report shows the same figures. Then the President brings the homes in from the community's spreadsheet, answers the rows that need a person, and the Treasurer approves the opening balances only when the total agrees with hers.

videos.title: A board member starts a free trial
videos.about: How a board member gets going on their own: confirm an email with a six-digit code, name the community, start the 30-day free trial with no card, set up two-factor sign-in, walk the ten setup steps, and land on the dashboard.

videos.title: A board member whose community is already here
videos.about: What happens when a board member starts a community that HOA HX already knows: it is found by name or by street address, they can ask to join it, or say theirs is a different community and go on.

videos.title: The request reaches the board, and they let her in
videos.about: What the community sees when someone asks to join from Get started: the HOA Administrator reads the request with where it came from, and the President lets the person in.

videos.title: A homeowner or tenant finds the way in
videos.about: The ways in for a homeowner or a tenant: an invitation link pasted here, what to do with no invitation yet, an owner's invitation for a tenant, and asking a community by its address.

videos.title: Welcome back
videos.about: What happens when someone who already has an account comes to Get started: they log in, come back to where they were, and the new community is added to the account they already have.

videos.title: When the trial ends before setup is finished
videos.about: What the free trial's end looks like: nothing while it runs, then a clear notice for the board with the plan page one click away, and no change at all for homeowners.

videos.title: A water main break: the board tells everyone
videos.about: How the board tells a street about a water main break, sees who has read it, sends an update and the all-clear; how a homeowner receives it and asks the office a question; and a routine notice from a template, saved and scheduled.

videos.title: The new parking rule: a document and a signature
videos.about: How the Secretary uploads a new rule, the President pins it and makes it required with a renewal date, asks a homeowner to sign, and everyone can see which version was signed.

videos.title: A leak at Sam's home, reported and fixed
videos.about: A leak at Sam's home: he reports it with a photo and a PDF, the manager triages and assigns a vendor with limited sharing, asks Sam a question, the vendor fixes it with photos, and Sam confirms. Closing: the vendor directory and after-hours help.

videos.title: Monday as the President: the work queue
videos.about: A Monday for the board: the work queue, three requests closed at once after a review, a message from a template, the roster export with its reason, a decision and a role's dates, and a manager with two communities.

videos.title: A home with a tenant
videos.about: How an owner invites a tenant with move-in dates, the tenant accepts and sees the home's codes, the household registers a pet and a vehicle that the Secretary reviews, and the owner pauses access and records the move-out.

videos.title: The pool party: an event, RSVPs and who to call
videos.about: How the Secretary posts a weekly event with an attachment, a homeowner RSVPs, chooses the day-before reminder and sees the trash and pickup schedule on the calendar, finds the board and after-hours contacts in the HOA directory, chooses what neighbors see of him, and the President looks up a private number with a reason that is logged.

videos.title: A home falls behind
videos.about: A home's balance goes past due: what the homeowner sees, and what the board sees, sends and records. Part one of two; the waiver and the plan are video 69.

videos.title: A late fee waived and a payment plan
videos.about: A home is behind: the Treasurer asks to waive a late fee, the President decides, then a payment plan is written, approved and accepted, and Sam sees it when a payment is missed. Part two of two; video 68 is part one.

videos.title: A rented home on file
videos.about: How staff record a rented home's occupancy and a cottage as a unit of the main home, how a lease is filed to the home and found by its owner and tenant, what the owner sees of the tenant's requests, and how a pet's private papers are added by the household and read by the reviewers.

videos.title: Act on several residents at once
videos.about: The HOA Administrator searches and filters the residents, selects three, deactivates them after a confirmation with a reason, then filters to Deactivated and reactivates them.
